_doc.about: save-clear settings. The plugin creates this file on first run; plugin updates never change it. Every value here is the default: an empty value means the built-in default. A plugin option (/config) or an environment variable wins over this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_doc.snapshot_dir: Where session summaries and compaction backups go. Empty = ~/.claude/snapshots
_doc.notify_command: Program called with one line of text when the automatic /clear succeeds, fails or is refused. Empty = no notifications
_doc.publish_link: on: publish the summary as a private claude.ai page (when the Artifact tool is available). off = no link
_doc.context_cap_tokens: Run save-clear at the end of the turn once the context passes this many tokens. Empty = 300000. 0 = off
_doc.idle_minutes: Idle trigger only (./install.sh --idle): minutes idle before an automatic save-clear. Empty = 50. 0 = off
_doc.idle_min_tokens: Idle trigger only: sessions with a smaller context are left alone. Empty = 80000
_doc.language: Language for the snapshot and the reply after the resume, e.g. Portuguese. Empty = the conversation's language
_doc.resume_message: Text typed (terminal) or sent by the relay (desktop app) right after the /clear. Empty = the built-in English request
_doc.extra_steps: Your own instructions the skill follows during the save: text, or the path of a file that holds them. Empty = none
_doc.on_save_command: Runs when the skill arms the resume (SAVE_CLEAR_SNAPSHOT set); what it prints is appended to the snapshot. Empty = none
_doc.pre_clear_command: Runs just before the automatic /clear or clear_session; never stops the clear. Empty = none
_doc.on_resume_command: Runs after the /clear when the summary is delivered; what it prints (exit 0) goes into the new session. Empty = none
